originalTitle: Market trading guide: CDSL among 2 stock recommendations for Monday
simplifiedContent: Here's what you need to know: the stock market had a big comeback on Friday, thanks to good news from around the world and strong earnings from tech companies. For Monday, some experts are suggesting that you consider buying stocks in two companies: CDSL and Sumitomo Chemical India. They think these stocks are good buys because their prices have recently broken out to new levels, they're being traded a lot, and other signs are pointing up. This could be a good opportunity to make some money, but it's always important to do your own research before making any investment decisions. The experts like these stocks because of their strong momentum and high trading volumes.

originalTitle: Vijay Kedia buys 3.58 lakh shares in this IT company that nearly doubled investor money
simplifiedContent: Vijay Kedia, a well-known investor, has bought a significant number of shares in a company called Exato Technologies, which is an IT firm. This means he now owns about 9.68% of the company. The company's stock price has gone up by over 90% in the last year, which is a big increase. This purchase has caught the attention of other investors, who are interested in small technology companies that have the potential to grow quickly. This matters because it could indicate that Exato Technologies is a company to watch, and its stock price may continue to rise.

originalTitle: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market had a good day on Friday, with two important indexes, the Sensex and Nifty, going up by over 1%. This happened because a big company called TCS had good earnings, which made investors feel more confident, and also because of positive news from other countries. Now, investors are waiting to see how companies did in the first quarter to decide what to do next with their money. They will also be looking at how the market is performing technically and what's happening in the rest of the world to figure out what might happen on Monday. This will help them make decisions about whether to buy or sell stocks.

originalTitle: Mcap of 4 of top-10 most valued firms jumps  ₹92,995 cr; HDFC Bank, Airtel top gainers
simplifiedContent: The value of four of the top 10 most valuable companies in the stock market increased by ₹92,995 crore. The companies that gained value were RIL, HDFC Bank, Bharti Airtel, and LIC. On the other hand, six other top companies, including ICICI Bank and SBI, lost a total of ₹49,294.13 crore in value. This means that the total value of these top companies changed, with some getting more valuable and others losing value. This matters because it shows which companies are currently doing well and which are not, which can affect the overall stock market.

originalTitle: Upcoming IPOs: SBI Funds Management IPO, Alpine Texworld IPO among new issues to open this week; full list here
simplifiedContent: This week, two companies, Alpine Texworld and SBI Funds Management, are going to sell their shares to the public for the first time through an Initial Public Offering (IPO). This means that people can buy shares of these companies and become part-owners. The two companies are expected to raise a total of around ₹9,900 crore from these sales. This is a significant amount of money, indicating that these companies are likely to be large and influential. The IPOs are happening on the main stock market board, which suggests that these companies are well-established and meet certain standards.

originalTitle: Expert view: Strong opening to Q1 with recovery in banks, says Vinod Nair
simplifiedContent: A financial expert named Vinod Nair says that the start of the first quarter of 2026 has been strong, especially for banks. According to data from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), the amount of money that banks have lent out has increased by 17.7% compared to the same time last year, which is the highest increase in two years. However, the amount of money that people have deposited into banks has only grown by 12% over the same period. This means that banks are lending out more money, which can be a good sign for the economy. The strong growth in lending suggests that banks are recovering, which is a positive development for the financial sector.
